# Claude

> > Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant platform offering enterprise solutions, desktop and mobile applications, integrations with Excel and PowerPoint, AI agents, and deployment options through Google Cloud Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock.

Claude provides AI capabilities across multiple tiers (Claude Max, Claude Team, Claude Enterprise) with features like Claude Code for development, Cowork for collaboration, and specialized integrations for productivity tools. The platform supports agentic workflows, voice input, and enterprise-grade deployment options.
